sources.title: STM32CubeAI-DC - Software - STMicroelectronics
sources.snippet: Description STM32Cube.AI Developer Cloud (STM32CubeAI-DC) is a free-of-charge online platform and services to create, optimize, benchmark, and generate artificial intelligence (AI) for the STM32 microcontrollers and microprocessors based on the Arm ® Cortex ® processors. It can leverage AI hardware acceleration (neural processing unit, NPU) whenever available in the target hardware.
